tour.skipped.toast: You can open the tour again under "Data and settings".
tour.restart.help: A short five-step introduction to the app.
tour.step1.title: What you can do here
tour.step1.body: The app picks random combinations for EuroJackpot and Lotto 6 aus 49, rates one of your own and checks tickets against real draws. Everything runs in your browser, with no account.
tour.step2.title: Every combination has the same chance
tour.step2.body: Whatever numbers you pick, the jackpot chance is 1 in 139,838,160, and the generator does not guess. Only the number of people you would share a prize with changes.
tour.step3.title: Save a ticket and check it
tour.step3.body: Press "Save to tickets", buy the ticket outside the app and keep the original receipt. After the draw the prize class appears on the "Tickets" screen by itself.
tour.step4.title: Odds and cost
tour.step4.body: The "Odds" screen shows the probabilities of every prize class and the expected return of a field. The "How much per year" calculator shows what your usual set costs.
tour.step5.title: Test any "system"
tour.step5.body: The "Strategy check" screen runs "hot" and "cold" numbers over every draw in the archive. They do no better than chance, and the figures show it.
settings.hints.title: Tips
settings.hints.help: Short tips on the screens. Stored in this browser only.
hint.global.tooMany.text: Tips getting in the way? You can switch them off under "Data and settings", and reopen the tour from there.
hint.gen.firstRun.text: Start with "Generate". The "Rarely chosen" mode is already on: it skips popular patterns, and the chance of winning stays the same.
hint.gen.saveFirst.text: Planning to play this combination? Save it to tickets: the app will check it after the draw and show the prize class.
hint.gen.popular.text: Field {n} triggers a strong popularity rule. If it wins, you would probably share the prize with more people. Generate it again?
hint.gen.randomMode.text: "Purely random" does not discard popular patterns such as dates up to 31. "Rarely chosen" does. The chance of winning is the same in both modes.
hint.gen.manyFields.text: {n} fields per draw cost about {year} a year. Every field has the same expected return per euro, so more fields mostly means more spending.
hint.gen.szAfterSave.text: The Superzahl is the last digit of the receipt number. Enter it on the ticket card after buying, or the classes with a Superzahl cannot be checked.
hint.eval.fix.dates.text: All numbers are 31 or lower, like dates. To stop the rule applying, change: {changes}. The chance stays the same; only your possible share changes.
hint.eval.fix.progression.text: The numbers are evenly spaced by {step}. Replace one, for example {changes}, and the sequence is gone. Such sequences appear among popular combinations.
hint.eval.fix.ticketPattern.text: All numbers lie on one line of the slip ({line}). Replace one, for example {changes}, and the pattern is gone: many people draw lines on the slip.
hint.eval.fix.pastWinning.text: This combination was drawn on {date}. Replace one number, for example {changes}: past winning combinations appear among popular ones.
hint.eval.mediumOnly.text: Only weak rules apply, so the estimate is "medium". Keep it as it is or change {changes}, and the estimate becomes "low".
hint.eval.low.text: No rule applies, so the combination looks rare. Its chance of winning is the same as any other, but you would probably share a prize less often.
hint.tickets.empty.text: How to start: generate a combination and save it, then open this screen after the draw. Already played? Add the ticket by hand.
hint.tickets.waiting.text: Your {game} tickets are waiting for the {date} draw. Open this screen after it: the prize class appears by itself once the draw is in the archive.
hint.tickets.drawMissing.text: By schedule the {game} draw of {date} has taken place but is not in the archive, so its tickets are unchecked. Update the draws or enter the numbers by hand.
hint.tickets.won.text: You have a win: class {class}. Check it against the official numbers and keep the receipt safe. The steps are in the guide.
hint.tickets.sz.text: Matches: {n}. With a matching Superzahl this would be class {class}. Enter the Superzahl from the receipt to see the exact result.
hint.tickets.deadlineSoon.text: The winning ticket for the {date} draw turns three years old on {deadline}. If it has not been paid out, contact your lottery company now.
hint.tickets.deadlineGrey.text: Three years from the {date} draw ended on {deadline}. Companies count the period differently (to year end or from the draw day), so call yours today.
hint.tickets.expired.text: For the winning ticket of the {date} draw the general limitation period ended on {deadline}. Ask your lottery company whether a payout is still possible.
hint.tickets.old.text: Tickets older than three years with no win can go: save them to JSON if you want the history, then delete them.
hint.tickets.export.text: Tickets are stored in this browser only. Export them to JSON: they are lost if the browser data is cleared.
hint.draws.stale.text: The {game} archive ends on {last}, but a draw was scheduled for {expected}. Update the draws or enter the numbers by hand.
hint.draws.open.text: Open any draw to see its numbers, your tickets for that date and the result; for EuroJackpot also the official prize amounts.
hint.odds.year.text: Over a year that is {spent}. On average about {back} comes back, a difference of about {loss}. It is an average: any single year can turn out differently.
hint.odds.jackpot.below.text: Jackpot in the pot: {jackpot}. The calculation gives an expected return of about {ev} per field at a price of {price}. The jackpot size does not change the chance of winning.
hint.odds.jackpot.notBelow.text: Jackpot in the pot: {jackpot}. The calculation gives {ev} at a price of {price}. It is an estimate from recent average quotas, and the chance of winning is still 1 in 139,838,160.
hint.stats.frequency.text: Frequencies cannot predict numbers: draws are independent. We ran "hot" and "cold" numbers over every draw in the archive; the result is on its own screen.
hint.stats.pLow.text: p = {p}: this also happens under pure chance, especially when many numbers are looked at at once. It is not a hint about which numbers to pick.
hint.backtest.none.text: No strategy stood out from chance. Only two things can be influenced: who you would share a prize with and how much you spend.
hint.backtest.popularity.text: Draws where at least 4 of 5 numbers are 31 or lower had more winners (index {popular} versus {unpopular}) and a smaller payout in class 3+0 ({payPop} versus {payUnpop}).
